items.title: PMP
clues: Selected buyers can bid for premium inventory.
A publisher sets me up with chosen buyers.
items.why: A PMP is a private auction for invited buyers.

items.title: SPO
clues: Buyers use me to cut out extra middlemen.
I look at which routes to an impression are best.
My name means supply path optimisation.
items.why: SPO helps buyers reach the same inventory by the cleanest, cheapest path.

items.title: Sellers.json
clues: I name who sells through an ad platform.
Buyers use me to check who is behind an impression.
items.why: sellers.json lets buyers see who an ad platform represents.
